paragraphs: This confidential offering memorandum has been prepared solely for discussion with prospective investors. It is not an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any security or interest. Any offering may be made only through definitive offering documents and in compliance with applicable law.

Information in this memorandum is based on sources believed to be reliable but has not necessarily been independently verified. No representation or warranty, express or implied, is made as to its accuracy or completeness. Prospective investors must conduct their own investigation and consult their legal, tax, and financial advisers.

Projections, forecasts, and forward-looking statements reflect assumptions and expectations as of the preparation date. Actual results may differ materially because of risks, uncertainties, market conditions, construction outcomes, operating performance, financing availability, and other factors. Past performance is not indicative of future results.

Interests in private real estate offerings are illiquid, speculative, and involve risk, including the possible loss of all invested capital. No public market may exist, distributions are not guaranteed, and investors should review all definitive offering documents before making an investment decision.
